meta.title: Offering more than the requested quantity is refused
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

resolved: “Enter 15 in the vendor portal's Quantity Available field and verify the product-specific refusal or capped quantity resp” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Configure an RFQ pricing stage for the vendor offer.
Apply a pricing template before adding the requested line item.
Create one line item with the requested quantity set to 10.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite one QA vendor to submit the offer.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its bid sheet.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
